content.text:
I changed `HibernateOrmProcessor.build` so the Hibernate ORM dev-mode integrators are recorded by class name. I haven't compiled it or run any tests, and I didn't reproduce the remote-dev failure. The offline Maven compile failed because the `eu.maveniverse.maven.nisse:extension3:0.9.5` extension isn't in the local repository.

The `ClassCastException` in the issue shows `HibernateOrmDevIntegrator` loaded by a `URLClassLoader` while the `Integrator` interface came from the `QuarkusClassLoader`. The processor was adding `HibernateOrmDevIntegrator.class` and `SchemaManagementIntegrator.class` as class literals, which resolve in whatever loader the deployment code ran in. In remote dev that is the wrong one. Both are now added through `recorderContext.classProxy(...)`, the same way the integrators found via service files already are, so the class is resolved by name at runtime in the application's class loader. I referenced `HibernateOrmDevIntegrator` by its string name and removed its import, since it lives in the runtime-dev module and a literal would load it in the deployment loader.

The cause is inferred from the stack trace. I haven't checked it in an actual remote-dev run, and I haven't checked whether `classProxy` finds the runtime-dev class in that setup.
